finding.claim: uncomputeOrdinal uses findIndex(i < ordinal) which always returns 0 for ordinal>=1, so month is always 1 and day equals ordinal; ordinal-to-gregorian conversion is wrong for any ordinal >31.
finding.title: uncomputeOrdinal always returns January

verifier.reason: The code at impl/conversions.js:42 uses table.findIndex((i) => i < ordinal) on ladders starting with 0 at impl/conversions.js:14-15, so for ordinal>=1 the first element satisfies the predicate, month0 is always 0, and impl/conversions.js:43-44 therefore return month 1 with day equal to ordinal, which is incorrect for ordinal>31.
